acceptanceCriteria: CI runs npm ci, lint, typecheck and npm test in extensions/vscode on every pull request that touches extensions/vscode/** or the MCP or CLI wire contracts it consumes.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. .github/workflows/ci.yml has no step that builds, lints, typechecks or tests extensions/vscode, so the extension's 84 tests run only when someone runs npm test by hand.
title: CI runs no VS Code extension job
